title: .gitignore 规则匹配器（glob 语义 + 否定优先级 + 目录坑）
expected_output:
=== .gitignore ===
  *.log
  build/
  /local.txt
  !keep.log
  **/cache/
  src/**/tmp.txt
  dist/*.js

=== 判定结果 ===
文件                     | 忽略     | 依据
----------------------------------------------------------------------
a.log                  | True   | 命中规则 '*.log'
sub/a.log              | True   | 命中规则 '*.log'
keep.log               | False  | 命中规则 '!keep.log'
build/app.js           | True   | 父目录 'build' 命中 'build/'，Git 不再递归其下文件
build/keep.txt         | True   | 父目录 'build' 命中 'build/'，Git 不再递归其下文件
local.txt              | True   | 命中规则 '/local.txt'
sub/local.txt          | False  | 无命中
server/cache/x.bin     | True   | 父目录 'server/cache' 命中 '**/cache/'，Git 不再递归其下文件
src/a/tmp.txt          | True   | 命中规则 'src/**/tmp.txt'
src/a/b/tmp.txt        | True   | 命中规则 'src/**/tmp.txt'
dist/app.js            | True   | 命中规则 'dist/*.js'
dist/sub/app.js        | False  | 无命中
README.md              | False  | 无命中

被忽略 9/13 个文件

=== 经典坑：父目录被排除时 ! 无法救回子文件 ===
  build/keep.txt   规则[build/ + !build/keep.txt] -> 忽略=True (父目录 'build' 命中 'build/'，Git 不再递归其下文件)
                   规则[build/* + !build/keep.txt] -> 忽略=False (命中规则 '!build/keep.txt')
  build/other.txt  规则[build/ + !build/keep.txt] -> 忽略=True (父目录 'build' 命中 'build/'，Git 不再递归其下文件)
                   规则[build/* + !build/keep.txt] -> 忽略=True (命中规则 'build/*')

  解释: Git 不会递归进入被排除的目录，因此目录内的 ! 规则没有机会生效；正确写法是先用量词 /* 包住目录内容，再用 ! 放行个别文件
code:
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

""".gitignore 语义要点：
1) 逐行按顺序匹配，**最后命中的规则生效**（所以 `!` 要写在忽略规则之后）；
2) 行首 `/` 锚定 .gitignore 所在目录；行尾 `/` 只匹配目录；
3) `*` 不跨 `/`，`?` 匹配单字符，`**/` 跨任意层，`/**/` 匹配零或多层；
4) 一旦某个**目录**被排除，其下的文件无法再被 `!` 重新纳入（经典坑）。"""
import re

RULES_TEXT = """*.log
build/
/local.txt
!keep.log
**/cache/
src/**/tmp.txt
dist/*.js
"""

FILES = [
    "a.log", "sub/a.log", "keep.log", "build/app.js", "build/keep.txt",
    "local.txt", "sub/local.txt", "server/cache/x.bin",
    "src/a/tmp.txt", "src/a/b/tmp.txt", "dist/app.js", "dist/sub/app.js", "README.md",
]


def compile_rule(raw):
    negate = raw.startswith("!")
    line = raw[1:] if negate else raw
    dir_only = line.endswith("/")
    if dir_only:
        line = line[:-1]
    anchored_root = line.startswith("/")
    if anchored_root:
        line = line[1:]
    has_slash = "/" in line
    regs = []
    for p in line.split("/"):
        if p == "**":
            regs.append("(?:.*/)?[^/]+")
        elif p == "*":
            regs.append("[^/]+")
        else:
            piece = ""
            for ch in p:
                if ch == "*":
                    piece += "[^/]*"
                elif ch == "?":
                    piece += "[^/]"
                elif ch in ".+^$(){}|\\":
                    piece += "\\" + ch
                else:
                    piece += ch
            regs.append(piece)
    body = "/".join(regs)
    # 含 internal '/' 或行首锚定 => 从 .gitignore 所在目录起整体匹配；否则只匹配 basename（任意深度）
    pattern = body if (has_slash or anchored_root) else "(?:.*/)?" + body
    return {"raw": raw, "negate": negate, "dir_only": dir_only,
            "regex": re.compile("^" + pattern + "$")}


def compile_rules(text):
    return [compile_rule(l) for l in text.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.startswith("#")]


def rule_hit(path, rules, is_dir):
    hit = None
    for r in rules:
        if r["dir_only"] and not is_dir:
            continue
        if r["regex"].match(path):
            hit = r
    return hit


def ignored(path, rules):
    """git 的判定：任何祖先目录被忽略 => 该文件一定被忽略，且 ! 无法救回。"""
    parts = path.split("/")
    for i in range(1, len(parts)):
        d = "/".join(parts[:i])
        h = rule_hit(d, rules, True)
        if h is not None and not h["negate"]:
            return True, "父目录 '%s' 命中 '%s'，Git 不再递归其下文件" % (d, h["raw"])
    h = rule_hit(path, rules, False)
    if h is None:
        return False, "无命中"
    return (not h["negate"]), ("命中规则 '%s'" % h["raw"])


rules = compile_rules(RULES_TEXT)
print("=== .gitignore ===")
for line in RULES_TEXT.splitlines():
    if line:
        print("  " + line)
print()
print("=== 判定结果 ===")
print("%-22s | %-6s | %s" % ("文件", "忽略", "依据"))
print("-" * 70)
ign_cnt = 0
for f in FILES:
    ig, why = ignored(f, rules)
    ign_cnt += 1 if ig else 0
    print("%-22s | %-6s | %s" % (f, str(ig), why))
print()
print("被忽略 %d/%d 个文件" % (ign_cnt, len(FILES)))
print()
print("=== 经典坑：父目录被排除时 ! 无法救回子文件 ===")
bad = compile_rules("build/\n!build/keep.txt\n")
good = compile_rules("build/*\n!build/keep.txt\n")
for path in ["build/keep.txt", "build/other.txt"]:
    ig_bad, why_bad = ignored(path, bad)
    ig_good, why_good = ignored(path, good)
    print("  %-16s 规则[build/ + !build/keep.txt] -> 忽略=%s (%s)" % (path, ig_bad, why_bad))
    print("  %-16s 规则[build/* + !build/keep.txt] -> 忽略=%s (%s)" % ("", ig_good, why_good))
print()
print("  解释: Git 不会递归进入被排除的目录，因此目录内的 ! 规则没有机会生效；"
      "正确写法是先用量词 /* 包住目录内容，再用 ! 放行个别文件")
